title: Phase-1 ground-truth stage-label record
description: One JSON object per stage execution, appended (NDJSON) to labels.ndjson by the deterministic orchestrator. Times are on the target board's chrony-disciplined CLOCK_REALTIME (the same clock its collectors stamp), captured by an on-device marker; monotonic times are per-board and used only for within-board sanity. The orchestrator ALSO writes a flat projection labels.csv (scenario_id,run_idx,attack_type,target,stage,start_iso,end_iso,start_ns,end_ns,guard_pre_s,guard_post_s) which pipeline/align_windows.py and pipeline/validate_alignment.py consume for interval-join labelling. `stage` values are ids from the canonical taxonomy stages.yaml (S0..S12).

stage_index.description: 0-based position of this stage within the scenario

target_device_id.description: device whose collectors this stage labels

action_ref.description: key into scenarios.yaml actions: (methodology-level tool reference)

action_cmd_sha256.description: sha256 of the fully-resolved command string (provenance; the string itself is NOT stored in the dataset)

sample_id.description: chain-of-custody id of the curated sample (contained stages only)

t_open_synced.description: epoch seconds (float, ns res) on target board's synced CLOCK_REALTIME at window OPEN, from the on-device marker

t_close_synced.description: epoch seconds on target board synced clock at window CLOSE

t_open_mono.description: target board CLOCK_MONOTONIC at open (within-board only)

orch_t_open.description: orchestrator (Windows) wall clock at open; validation only

clock_skew_ms.description: target-vs-time_master chrony offset at stage start (ms), from run manifest preflight

guard_pre_s.description: seconds trimmed off the FRONT of [t_open,t_close] to form the CORE interval

guard_post_s.description: seconds trimmed off the END to form the CORE interval

primary_modality.description: expected_primary_source from stages.yaml — the a-priori HYPOTHESIS for the dominant source; analysis metadata, NEVER a feature or the label source

expected_modalities.description: concurrency validity gate: sources expected to react

validity_gate_passed.description: true iff >=2 expected modalities showed a reaction above baseline in the core interval (Charter principle #2)

remote_exit_code.description: attacker action exit code; null if terminated on window close
